verdict.rationale: Leaving is credible: the agents framework is open source and pip/npm-installable without a key, the LiveKit server backbone is Apache-2.0 and was self-hosted hands-on without an account, and the open-source plugins connect directly to many model providers, so there is little lock-in to LiveKit Cloud. Nothing in the evidence documents exporting data held on LiveKit Cloud, such as deployments, recordings, transcripts or call data, in open formats. That leaves the 'export all my data' half of the story unevidenced. Missing for 10: a documented data-export feature for LiveKit Cloud, named open export formats, coverage of all data types, and independent confirmation of a clean migration off the Cloud.
